gen-fs-new-title-gf-aleo: Letters locked together like links in a fine chain give New Title a bold, modern bite, with lowercase stretching upward. Aleo does the quieter work, its open counters letting the eye drift through.
gen-fs-new-title-gf-almendra-sc: New Title links its letters like a fine chain and lifts its lowercase high above the capitals, bold and modern. Almendra SC keeps its mouths open and dignified, built for steady reading.
gen-fs-new-title-gf-antic-slab: Chain-link letters pressed tight and a lowercase that towers over its capitals give New Title a bold, modern grip. Antic Slab follows with round, uniform bowls and wide s curves.
gen-fs-new-title-gf-arvo: New Title links its letters like a fine chain, with lowercase that rises high and a bold, modern feel. Then Arvo, whose curves refuse to close, gives extended reading a traditional, dignified voice.
gen-fs-new-title-gf-belgrano: Modern in attitude, New Title locks its letters like links in a fine chain and raises its lowercase high. Belgrano brings classic, traditional curves that stay open and clear.
gen-fs-new-title-gf-biorhyme-expanded: Refined and bookish, BioRhyme Expanded opens gaps that split each word into single letters. But New Title locks its letters like chain links, bold and modern with high lowercase, a sharp foil.
gen-fs-new-title-gf-biz-udmincho: New Title locks its letters together like links in a fine chain. BIZ UDMincho follows with a shallow terminal curl and wide gaps, and its moderate lowercase sits lower beside the heading's high one.
gen-fs-new-title-gf-copse: Copse lets visible daylight through every curved opening, giving a literary, classic voice under the heading. And New Title, with its chain-linked letters and high lowercase, supplies all the bold, modern punch.
gen-fs-new-title-gf-cutive: Refined and literary, Cutive spreads wide tracking through running text while New Title locks its letters into a bold chain. The generous opening in c meets a high lowercase up top.
gen-fs-new-title-gf-david-libre: Dignified and refined, David Libre reads with terminals that hang open, giving each line a patient, measured pace. New Title does the shouting, bold and modern; David Libre does the persuading.
